title: SWF export: bitmaps, filters, text
description: Extend SWF compiler to emit BitmapDisplayObject as DefineBitsLossless2 + PlaceObject2, FlashFilter effects as SWF filter tags (DefineShape4 filter list, DropShadowFilter/GlowFilter/BlurFilter SWF structs), and TextDisplayObject as DefineText/DefineEditText tags. Requires extending packages/swf/src/compile.ts and adding new encoder files. See docs/14-publishing-export.md and docs/15-file-formats-fla-swf.md.
